summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Inceptions
summary.text: Continuation of an astrological chapter list covering questions about omens, phases, inceptions, lots of fortune, solar bound-rulers and faces, human or monstrous nativities, legal cases, lost objects, runaways, thieves, and active or inactive days. Authorities and cross-references include Dorotheus, Erasistratus, Timaeus Praxidus, Serapion, and Hephaestus, with a parallel reference to Codex Vaticanus 7 and editions in Catalogus I.
